name: oc8-copilot
description: Configure and manage a live oc8 tenant (departments, agents, missions, guardrails, triggers, plugins, integrations) through oc8's external Copilot MCP gateway, and turn a plain-language request like "set up a support team that escalates billing issues over €200" into the right sequence of proposals. Use this whenever the user gives you an oc8 API key (`oc8_ak_...`), an oc8 tenant URL, or asks you to set up, configure, hire, connect, automate, or change guardrails/permissions in their oc8 instance -- even if they just describe the outcome they want and never mention "Copilot" or "MCP" by name.
